author: georgia🕸
title: Looking for artist for Christmas card design
content:
I’m looking for an artist to commission for a Christmas card design for my small business to give to clients.

Ideally UK based (Yorkshire even better!), cartoon style and if possible already have some pet (mostly dogs) illustrations available to show me your art style.

Follow-up: I know I’m late looking, ideally I would like the artwork done by 4th December so I can get them printed at a local printers and sent out to my clients in decent time. If you’re interested or know someone who might be please let me know! Thank you!
